days.file: Tobit en Anna met het bokje Rijksmuseum SK-A-4717.jpeg
days.title: Tobit and Anna with the Kid
days.alt: Old blind Tobit sits with his hands clasped in prayer while his wife Anna leans over him, holding a young goat.
days.look: Look again at Tobit’s clasped hands. What longing would you lay before God today?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Murillo, Bartolomé Estéban - The Infant Christ as the Good Shepherd - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Infant Christ as the Good Shepherd
days.alt: The child Jesus, holding a shepherd's staff, rests his hand on a lamb that has come close to him.
days.look: Look again at the small hand resting on the lamb. Can you believe you are loved this tenderly?
days.license: Artist died 1682; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Accademia - Archangel Raphael and Tobit by Titian.jpg
days.title: The Archangel Raphael and Tobias
days.alt: The archangel Raphael, wings spread, holds young Tobias by the hand and points the way ahead.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s hand around Tobias’s hand. Where do you need a guide right now?
days.license: Artist died 1576; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Ruth and Naomi
days.alt: Ruth and her mother-in-law Naomi stand close together under a tree, speaking earnestly with hands raised.
days.look: Look again at Ruth’s hand held to her heart. What would patient, faithful love ask of you?
days.license: Artist died 1676; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Rembrandt Harmensz. van Rijn - Zelfportret als de apostel Paulus - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: Self-Portrait as the Apostle Paul
days.alt: Rembrandt, painted as the aged Apostle Paul in a pale turban, looks out with a thoughtful, weathered face.
days.look: Look again at Paul’s searching, weathered face. What do you want to see more clearly?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Hendrick Bloemaert - Penitent King David - O 1647 - National Gallery Prague.jpg
days.title: The Penitent King David
days.alt: King David kneels in his royal robes beside his harp, his hands pressed to his chest, looking upward in prayer.
days.look: Look again at David’s hands pressed to his heart. What would you ask God to make clean in you?
days.license: Artist died 1672; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: The Marriage Feast at Cana MET DT1459.jpg
days.title: The Marriage Feast at Cana
days.place: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
days.alt: At the wedding table, Jesus raises his hand in blessing while Mary, in a white veil beside him, presses her hands together.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s joined hands beside her Son. What are you waiting for that you can simply tell Him?
days.license: Artist died 1519; Commons: CC0 (Metropolitan Museum open access)

days.title: The Annunciation
days.alt: The angel Gabriel bows low before Mary, who sits with her arms crossed over her chest beneath the arches of a loggia.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s arms crossed over her heart. Could you say yes to a plan you cannot yet see?
days.license: Artist died 1455; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: The Calling of Saints Peter and Andrew - Caravaggio (1571-1610).jpg
days.title: The Calling of Saints Peter and Andrew
days.alt: Two bearded fishermen, Peter and Andrew, gesture in surprise beside Jesus, who points the way as he calls them to follow.
days.look: Look again at the hands of the two fishermen, caught between their nets and the call. What would you leave in God’s hands to follow where He leads?
days.license: Artist died 1610; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
